correctness.rationale: Step 1 proves v5(F_m)=v5(m) and the exact leading-unit coefficient from a terminating Binet expansion. The companion-matrix Q^20=I+5B mod25 and nonzero four slopes give index isometry on equal mod4 classes. For 5∤d the unit power map lifts isometrically on each mod5 unit ball, which is surjective by equal finite cardinalities. Combining modulo-four cases gives all output units and exact fibers; the nonzero count, zero fiber, least periods and Haar measure follow without extrapolating finite checks. The checker passed 221548 exact assertions in 70 cases.

value.rationale: The complete five-adic output image, every finite-modulus fiber size, least period and measure for all d coprime to five constitute a natural exact classification of polynomially sampled Fibonacci values. Valuation restrictions alone omit the sharp unit obstruction exactly for exponents divisible by four. The result complements arithmetic-progression equiprobability and the dynamical realizability literature, with the substantive known precursor and limits identified.
